audit_anchor: #include "rules/audits/r845_batch.h"  // R845: R845 eighth FF promotion audit
audit_comment: THE FF MONSTER LEVEL TABLES - the ten Monster Level grids (the print pp. 100-110) with their eleven subtables: the eight Dragon Subtables keyed to Levels III through X (the Levels I and II grids carry no dragon rows), the Sphinx Subtable (the Level VII routing target), the Human Subtable (the Level I routing target) and the Character Subtable (the every-level routing target). THE WALK: 21 grids, 461 rows, every cell pinned (die band, roster ordinal, source, numbers, special; the dragon rows die band, type, age, hit points per die). THE SOURCES: the three-voice scan collation from the archive.org item tsr02012fiendfolio (the djvu text, the word-geometry xml, the abbyy char xml) with the 995 landed registry defs the advisory voice - the src census walks 193 MM1 rows, 133 FF rows, 20 routing rows and 14 unkeyed rows and NO MM2 row (the print lists MM1 and FF creatures only). THE REPAIRS (39, the R703 pattern): every repair forced by the 01-00 contiguity or corroborated by the def - the Level I shrieker band (the ink 60-84 reads 80-84) and the snyad numbers, the Level II crabman band and the poltergeist numbers, the Level III drow and garbug bands, the Level IV blink dog and werewolf bands and the yellow musk creeper rows, the Level V snake band and the xill row 00, the Level VI carrion crawler, lammasu and medusa bands, the Level VII efreeti band (the ink 23 reads 28) and the xorn row 00 (the ink Korn), the Level VIII ice devil band (the ink T9 reads 19), the Level IX guardian naga and nycadaemon bands and the vampire band, the Dragon Subtable red and silver bands (the D4 ink 75-02 and 83-38) and the D7 bronze and red bands. THE DEFECT PINS (2): the Level III wererat band 56-63 double-lists the four following rows (59, 60, 61-62, 63) - pinned as ink, the grid does NOT assert its full tiling; the Level VIII ink skips the die band 27-28 (the Giant, cloud row 25-26 jumps to the Giant, fog row 29-30 in both voices) - pinned as ink. THE NOTED INK: the D3 hit-points cells garble (pinned unreadable), the D4 subtable carries no hit-points column, the D10 hit-points cells garble beyond the Copper row (pinned unreadable), the Level X AC column prints blank except the Beholder (0/2/7) and the Elemental Prince of Evil (Var), the Level X asterisk rows read select one or find randomly, the vampire footnotes ride the Level IX (former evil cleric, 7th-10th level) and Level X (former magic-user, 9th-12th level) rows, the Level IX xorn numbers read 2-9 in both voices (the def reads 2-5), the pyrohydra and piercer rows ride no single registry def (the four MM1 piercer size defs; unkeyed), and the ink name variants (Anhkheg, Korn, Elf drew, Meazle, Snayd, XIII, BuJette and the rest) pin as scanned with the roster riding the cleaned print names. No defs promoted this round - the registry floor holds at 995; the round-roster ordinal (333 labels) walks every creature, routing label, sphinx type, human row, character class and dragon type the grids carry.
